reasoning_details.text:
**Estimating Effort Now**

I'm currently focusing on the effort estimation for the software increment. My primary task is to analyze the provided specification and user stories within the Spring XD/Spring Framework context to determine the required work-hours.

**Analyzing User Stories**

My current focus is on dissecting user stories related to Sqoop metastore customization, module registry documentation, and a unified REST API for metrics retrieval. I'm also considering the implications of using a Boot-based ModuleRunner and secured GF source integration.

**Refining Dependencies Now**

I'm now concentrating on user stories U7 and U8. My current effort is focused on untangling mock repository dependencies for improved testability and considering the migration of the Project Reactor data processor module to the core for native Reactor Stream API utilization.

**Estimating Metrics Handlers**

I'm now focused on the effort estimation for U1, specifically for the `/metrics/counters/all`, `/metrics/gauges/all`, and `/metrics/rich-gauges/all` handlers, considering both collection/paged and full list return types.

**Estimating Development Time**

I'm now calculating the effort for several key features, including Sqoop metastore configuration, HDFS module registry documentation, bulk metrics endpoints, a Boot-based ModuleRunner, Gemfire source security, a `jdbcgpfdist` batch job, test infrastructure refactoring, and migrating the Reactor module to core.

technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Expose configurable Sqoop metastore properties (JDBC URL, driver, username, password) via Spring XD configuration files to allow external databases.
U2: Author comprehensive documentation guidelines and configuration examples for HDFS-backed module registry (XD-2287) in standard AsciiDoc/Markdown format.
U3: Add bulk REST API GET endpoints (/metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, /metrics/rich-gauges/all) in Spring XD Admin UI/REST controller layer returning JSON collections.

U4: Develop a Boot-based ModuleRunner main class and launcher to allow execution of individual XD modules within container-managed environments (e.g., Kubernetes/Cloud Foundry) without full xd-container bootstrapping.
U5: Extend the GemFire (GF) source module configuration to pass through security credentials and properties to Gemfire ClientCache, and document security setup.
U6: Adapt existing gpfdist sink logic into a Spring Batch ItemWriter to create an out-of-the-box 'jdbcgpfdist' batch job definition for reading from JDBC and writing via gpfdist.
U7: Restructure test infrastructure configuration to separate mock repository beans from real/embedded repository implementations using Spring profiles and isolated test context configurations.
U8: Relocate the spring-xd-reactor processor codebase into core spring-xd repositories and integrate Reactor Stream API support directly into core module runtime execution.
assumptions: A single software developer will perform all design, implementation, testing, code migration, and documentation activities.
The target codebase is Spring XD based on Java 17 / Spring Boot and related ecosystem dependencies.
Required build tools, existing integration test suites, and mock environments are available and functional.
No external third-party API dependencies require blocking permissions or credentials beyond standard local mock setups.

activities.activity_description: Modify Sqoop integration modules to expose metastore connection properties and support user-specified databases instead of defaulting to the internal metastore configuration.
Create user documentation covering recommended configuration options, properties, and deployment scenarios for HDFS-backed module registries.

activities.activity_name: Develop Bulk Metrics REST API Endpoints (U3)
activities.activity_description: Implement REST controllers and service methods for /metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, and /metrics/rich-gauges/all to return aggregated metric data in a single request.

activities.activity_name: Create Boot-Based ModuleRunner for Standalone Execution (U4)
activities.activity_description: Build Spring Boot-based ModuleRunner class and application setup to execute Spring XD modules independently in containerized or container-managed runtimes without requiring xd-containers.

activities.activity_name: Add GemFire Source Native Security Support & Docs (U5)
activities.activity_description: Update the GemFire source module to accept and propagate native security properties and credentials for secure GemFire cluster authentication, along with documentation updates.
Create the jdbcgpfdist out-of-the-box batch job by refactoring the gpfdist sink writer into a Spring Batch ItemWriter and wiring it with a JDBC ItemReader.
Decouple mock repository implementations from real repository dependencies in test infrastructure, creating clear test profiles and thin dependency test contexts.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Project Reactor Processor Module to Core (U8)
activities.activity_description: Move spring-xd-reactor project components into core repository, update build scripts, and integrate Reactor Stream API natively into core processor execution components.
Execute comprehensive end-to-end integration tests, regression checks, and build validation across all updated modules and core components.
